program.section_heading: Film, Television and Electronic Media Associate in Science Degree for Transfer
outcomes: Students will develop a comprehensive set of skills and in-depth knowledge essential for careers in film, video, and television production. They will gain hands-on experience in directing, camera operation, lighting design, sound recording, and post-production editing. Through practical training and theoretical study, students will learn how to craft compelling visual narratives, effectively manage production workflows, and utilize industry-standard equipment and software. Additionally, they will acquire problem-solving abilities and creative techniques that will prepare them for various roles in the ever-evolving media and entertainment industry. Upon successful completion of the Associate in Science in Film, Television, and Electronic Media for Transfer Degree, students will have the necessary preparation required for admittance into a similar major within the California State University system per SB 1440.
